premises.text: Busy parents lack ready access to kids' critical medical information when caregivers or emergencies demand it
premises.evidence_span: how many of you would know what's the last immunization your kid had if you were asked in the emergency room?

premises.text: A new law lets patients own medical records and requires doctors to provide them after a proper release
premises.evidence_span: a law passed which says you now own your medical records. And once a proper release is signed, a doctor has to provide it to you in a timely fashion

premises.text: Parent-focused subscription service delivers immunizations, growth charts, and milestones via secure web and mobile app
premises.evidence_span: a subscription service that's going to provide to you all this information available from a secure website and a mobile app

premises.text: Electronic release triggers faxed records that the firm ingests and customer service uploads, making it effortless for the parent
premises.evidence_span: We in turn take that release, send it to your doctor and your doctor will now use a new technology we like to call the fax
